references.title: Nghị định 74/2024/NĐ-CP art.3: monthly and hourly minimum wages by region from 1 July 2024; an hourly-paid worker is held to the hourly column. Decree 74/2024 art.4 (December 2025) and Decree 293/2025 art.4 (2026 onward): minimum wages govern wage agreements and payment; weekly wages convert at 52/12. Art.4(3): weekly and daily wages may satisfy either the monthly or the hourly minimum after conversion using lawful normal working time.
Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.105(1)–(2): normal hours at most 8 a day and 48 a week; Decree 145/2020/NĐ-CP arts.54(1)(a3)–(a4), 55(1)(a). The fallback is used only where the entity plans no shifts.
Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.106: night work is counted from 22:00 to 06:00 the next morning.

Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 arts.90(2), 91; Decree 74/2024/NĐ-CP art.3 (the version’s rules.minimum_wage.by_region). An entity without a recorded region is checked against Region IV, the lowest floor; part-time, probation (at least 85% of the job wage, art.26) and intern terms are outside the monthly check.

rules.description: A monthly wage for the job below the regional minimum wage of the entity’s region.
rules.when: !(terms.employment_type in ["PART_TIME", "PROBATION", "INTERN"]) && terms.base_salary > 0.0 && terms.base_salary < double(rules.minimum_wage.by_region[company.region in ["II", "III", "IV"] ? company.region : "I"])
rules.message: The monthly wage is below the regional minimum wage for the entity’s region (Labour Code art.90(2), art.91).

references.title: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.107(2)(b): overtime may not exceed 40 hours a month. Counted: derived overtime on working days, and every paid hour on a rest day or public holiday.

rules.description: Overtime above 40 hours in the month.
rules.when: sum(work.days.map(d, (work.holidays.exists(h, h.date == d.date && h.kind in ["PUBLIC_HOLIDAY", "SUBSTITUTE", "DOUBLE_HOLIDAY"] && (h.given_to != "ONLY_IF_OFF_ON_REPLACED_DATE" || (h.replaces != "" && !(h.replaces in work.dates)))) || d.day_type in ["REST", "OFF"]) ? d.worked_hours : d.overtime_hours)) > 40.0
rules.message: overtime exceeds 40 hours in the month (Labour Code art.107(2)(b)).

references.title: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.107(2)(a): overtime at most 50% of the normal hours of a day; under a weekly regime normal plus overtime hours at most 12 a day.

rules.description: Overtime above half the normal hours of a day, or a day above 12 hours under the weekly regime.
rules.when: (has(terms.facts.normal_hours_arrangement) && terms.facts.normal_hours_arrangement == "WEEKLY") ? work.days.exists(d, d.scheduled_hours + d.overtime_hours > 12.0) : work.days.exists(d, d.scheduled_hours > 0.0 && d.overtime_hours > 0.5 * d.scheduled_hours)
rules.message: a day’s overtime exceeds the daily limit (Labour Code art.107(2)(a)).

references.title: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.102(3): the monthly deduction may not exceed 30% of the monthly wage actually paid after compulsory social insurance, health insurance, unemployment insurance and personal income tax.

rules.description: A damage-compensation deduction above 30% of the month’s wage after compulsory insurance and PIT.
rules.when: has(payslip.lines.PROPERTY_DAMAGE_COMPENSATION) && -payslip.lines.PROPERTY_DAMAGE_COMPENSATION > 0.3 * (payslip.gross - payslip.statutory_employee)
rules.message: the damage deduction exceeds 30% of the wage after SI, HI, UI and PIT (Labour Code art.102(3)); the slip is held.

references.title: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.107(2)(b): at most 200 hours a year; art.107(3): 300 hours in the sectors and cases listed, after notifying the provincial labour authority (art.107(4); Decree 145/2020/NĐ-CP arts.61–62). Counted from hours.year: all overtime (banked included; every hour on a 0-hour rest day) plus the planned hours worked on public, substitute and double holidays, each hour once.

rules.description: Overtime above 200 hours in the calendar year, or 300 in the sectors and cases Decree 145/2020 art.61 lists.
rules.when: (hours.year.overtime_hours + max(0.0, (has(hours.year.holiday_kind) && has(hours.year.holiday_kind.PUBLIC_HOLIDAY) ? hours.year.holiday_kind.PUBLIC_HOLIDAY.worked_hours : 0.0) - (has(hours.year.holiday_kind) && has(hours.year.holiday_kind.PUBLIC_HOLIDAY) ? hours.year.holiday_kind.PUBLIC_HOLIDAY.overtime_hours : 0.0)) + max(0.0, (has(hours.year.holiday_kind) && has(hours.year.holiday_kind.SUBSTITUTE) ? hours.year.holiday_kind.SUBSTITUTE.worked_hours : 0.0) - (has(hours.year.holiday_kind) && has(hours.year.holiday_kind.SUBSTITUTE) ? hours.year.holiday_kind.SUBSTITUTE.overtime_hours : 0.0)) + max(0.0, (has(hours.year.holiday_kind) && has(hours.year.holiday_kind.DOUBLE_HOLIDAY) ? hours.year.holiday_kind.DOUBLE_HOLIDAY.worked_hours : 0.0) - (has(hours.year.holiday_kind) && has(hours.year.holiday_kind.DOUBLE_HOLIDAY) ? hours.year.holiday_kind.DOUBLE_HOLIDAY.overtime_hours : 0.0))) > ((has(company.facts.overtime_300h_sector) && company.facts.overtime_300h_sector == true) ? 300.0 : 200.0)
rules.message: overtime this year exceeds 200 hours (300 in the listed sectors) (Labour Code art.107(2)(b), (3)).

references.title: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.112(1) (11 days: 1 January; five days of Tết; Hùng Kings 10/3 lunar; 30 April; 1 May; 2 September and one adjacent day) and art.111(3) (a holiday on the weekly rest day is taken on the next working day); Tết 2026 and 2 September 2026 per Bộ Nội vụ Thông báo 9441/TB-BNV of 16 October 2025 (16–20 February 2026; 1–2 September 2026); 24 November from 1 July 2026 per Nghị quyết 28/2026/QH16 art.2 (https://vanban.chinhphu.vn/?classid=1&docid=218008&orggroupid=1&pageid=27160).  https://congbaocdn.chinhphu.vn/CongBaoCP/VanBan/2019/11/30232/29070-1-2019993-99445-2019-qh14.pdf

references.title: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.25: at most 180 days for an enterprise manager, 60 for a college-level job, 30 for an intermediate or technical job, 6 working days for any other.

rules.description: A probation longer than the job class allows.

references.title: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.137(1)(a): unless she agrees, no night work, overtime or long business trips from the seventh month of pregnancy (sixth in remote areas) or while raising a child under 12 months. Read on employee.children (estimated_delivery_date three months ahead, child_birthdate) and the day’s consent (work.days[].overtime_consented, the work-day sheet’s per-day consent column: owner ruling, consent is per day, never an employee fact).

rules.description: Night work or overtime by a worker from the seventh month of pregnancy or with a child under 12 months, without her consent recorded for that day.
rules.when: work.days.exists(d, (employee.children.exists(c, has(c.estimated_delivery_date) && c.estimated_delivery_date != "" && (!has(c.child_birthdate) || c.child_birthdate == "") && d.date >= add_months(c.estimated_delivery_date, -3)) || employee.children.exists(c, has(c.child_birthdate) && c.child_birthdate != "" && add_months(c.child_birthdate, 12) > d.date)) && !(has(d.overtime_consented) && d.overtime_consented == true) && (d.overtime_hours > 0.0 || hours_between(d.intervals, rules.night_window.from, rules.night_window.to) > 0.0))

references.title: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.146(1)(b): a worker from 15 to under 18 works at most 8 hours a day and 40 a week, overtime and night work only in the jobs the Minister lists (term fact minor_listed_job).

references.title: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.111(1): at least 24 consecutive hours of rest each week; where the cycle does not allow it, at least four days a month on average (entity fact rest_averaged_monthly).

Mau D02-LT.xlsx” and its guide “3a. HD Mau D02-LT.docx”, read 2026-10-08 https://baohiemxahoi.gov.vn/vanban/Pages/default.aspx?ItemID=5018 (files https://baohiemxahoi.gov.vn:4545/File_Server_BHXH/documents/BHXHVN_366-QD-BHXH_2942026.pdf and https://baohiemxahoi.gov.vn:4545/File_Server_BHXH/documents/Mau%20bieu.rar); Law 41/2024/QH15 arts.28(1), 33(5), 53(8).

rules.description: Part B of the D02-LT list (columns A, B and 1–19) for the selected run’s month: a row for each SI participant hired in the month (Tăng lao động, from the month when the month is charged, else the next), each contract term starting in the month after the first (Điều chỉnh tiền lương, from the month) and each exit in the month (Giảm lao động do nghỉ việc, from the next month when the month is charged, else the month; the termination date in column 19). Column 4 is the term’s base salary, column 9 the allowances of the SI salary (the SI assessment’s), columns 10–12 the contract type. Columns 5–8 (state pay scale) are left empty. Customer input: employee facts si_number (column 1, empty for a first registration: VSS issues it) and hi_registered_facility (column 16), entity fact vss_result_delivery (column 17). Outside compulsory SI (a pensioner, a domestic worker, a contract under one month) is not listed. Part A (the unit) is the VSS registration. A month the SI rule did not charge (14 or more unpaid, sick or maternity working days, Law 41/2024 art.33(5), or a maternity month, art.53(8)) with the slip’s leave of those classes (slips[].leave) is listed as a reduction for that month only (columns 14 and 15 the month: the guide’s “từ tháng … đến tháng”, so participation resumes the next month unless the next month’s list reduces it again), its reason by the class with the most days — Giảm do nghỉ thai sản (maternity, miscarriage, prenatal, contraception, paternity), Giảm do nghỉ ốm đau (sick, child sick care, convalescence) or Giảm do nghỉ không hưởng lương (unpaid, unpaid bereavement, a stoppage by the worker’s fault) — and each leave’s dates in column 19 (the guide: “ghi rõ thời gian nghỉ … vào cột 19”). The hire and exit months keep their own rows (VN-OBLIGATION-52). The unpaid-leave reduction (Giảm do nghỉ không hưởng lương) stops BHXH and BHTN only: health insurance stays charged on the payslip, and column 19 says so (“BHYT tiếp tục đóng”). Decision 366/QĐ-BHXH Điều 4(2)(b) leaves the contribution to Law 41/2024 arts.33–34 and the HI Law arts.13, 15; Law 41/2024 art.33(5) waives only SI for 14 or more unpaid working days, and neither the HI Law as amended by Law 51/2024 nor Decree 188/2025 arts.6–8 (signed scan pp.6–12, read 2026-10-08) waives HI for unpaid days — HI moves to the fund only for 14 or more sickness or maternity days (HI Law art.12(2)(b)), so those reductions cover all three.
